      }
    } else if (t < 3900) {
      // mouth close-up, zooming in and shaking with laughter (rest pose at t = 3550)
      d = t - 3550;
      s = 1 + d * 0.0006;
      ph = d / 140 * TAU;
      tf(elF.ch, 'translate(90,' + n(140 + 2 * Math.sin(ph)) + ') scale(' + n(s) + ') translate(-90,-140)');
      tf(elF.mini, 'translate(' + n(295 + d * 0.01) + ',' + n(95 + d * 0.02) + ') scale(1.3)');
      tf(elF.bg, 'translate(0,' + n(-d * 0.01) + ')');
    } else {
      // aerial view, falling away from the camera (poses at t = 4250 and t = 4950)
      u = (t - 4250) / 700;
      vv = Math.max(0, u);
      tf(elG.bg, 'translate(0,' + n(-60 * u) + ')');
      cx = lerp(168, 143, u);
      cy = lerp(222, 187, u);
      s = lerp(1, 0.78, u);
      rot = lerp(0, -18, u);
      tf(elG.ch, 'translate(' + n(cx) + ',' + n(cy) + ') rotate(' + n(rot) + ') scale(' + n(s) + ')');
      ph = (t - 4250) / (700 / 3) * TAU;
      s = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(ph);
      tf(elG.mouth, 'translate(' + n(-5 - 14 * vv) + ',0) scale(' + n(s) + ') translate(5,0)');
      tf(elG.eyes, 'translate(' + n(-12 * vv) + ',' + n(4 * vv) + ')');
      for (i = 0; i < aerialMinis.length; i++) {
        m = aerialMinis[i];
        tf(m.el, 'translate(' + n(lerp(m.x0, m.x1, u)) + ',' + n(lerp(m.y0, m.y1, u)) + ') rotate(' +
          n(m.r + m.w * (t - 4250)) + ') scale(' + n(lerp(m.s0, m.s1, u)) + ')');
      }
    }
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
